[[File:Orray.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Geonosian picador riding atop an [[Orray/Legends|orray]].]]
A '''picador''' was an individual who rode a domesticated mount beast, and kept order with mostly undomesticated beasts in a staged event, such as a fight, or an arena.

'''Geonosian picadors''' were drones who maintained control of the creatures and criminals in the [[Petranaki arena|Geonosis arena]]. The job of picador was one of the few positions of note to which a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] drone could aspire. Drones of any caste could become picadors after they had proved themselves in the arena. Upon acceptance, the drones would learn the work of goading beasts and removing bodies using domesticated [[Orray/Legends|orrays]] that served as mounts during [[Petranaki arena]] events. Mounted picadors used a [[Static pike/Legends|static pike]] to control beasts.
